Yeah! Let us help out too!

—Clear skies. A large crowd had gathered to watch the mock race
that Jungle Pocket was running in. I came to cheer her on alongside her crew.
.........There's no way you didn't feel frustrated.
You were supposed to win the Derby. I know you were.

If I was born an Umamusume, I wanna run. If I'm gonna run, I wanna be "the strongest."
I wanna beat the tough ones, win and win and keep on winning, all the way to the top.

Pace-making, running errands, we'll do whatever it takes!
So anyway, we're countin' on you too.

—It blew my mind. Just when you thought it was a close race,
she shifted into another gear... and pulled away in the blink of an eye!

On a stage packed with absolute powerhouses, blowin' past every single one of 'em!
That was the exact "strength" I've been searchin' for.

Why can she face things head-on with such direct conviction?
Why go out of her way to take the thorny path—

Do that, and Jungle Pocket's fierce fighting spirit will truly shine in races.
Then that spirit will explode into a long, powerful final kick down the stretch—

She might also need to get used to tight tracks... Instead of forcing acceleration around turns,
there's the option of taking smart lines. Pour everything into the final stretch and sweep past them all at once!

Bring it on!
I'll master all of it and become "the strongest"!!

...! Heh... Nice. —I like that!
What else? Got anything more!?
Your brother did...?

With that level of skill, she's bound to have a spectacular debut.
On the flip side, debuting in the same class as her means facing a massive wall—

Oh... Come to think of it, I haven't told you yet, have I? The first Twinkle Series race
I ever watched was Fuji-san's.

HELL YEAH!! I'm gonna win the Debut Race, beat Tachyon down—
and take the Derby for myself!!

Since then, Jungle Pocket hasn't stopped running.
The shock of being shown such overwhelming dominance must have been immeasurable—

It started when my brother became her attending physician.
Four races since her debut—every single one of them was truly "the strongest" performance.

Even after I entered the Academy, she's taught me all sorts of stuff.
She's always perfect, never showin' anything but her coolest side. But—
Damn it—Tachyon...!!

For now, we're trainin' every single day until the Debut Race, so no more goofin' off.
Meet here this afternoon. Countin' on you guys too!

Ah, dammit! Tachyon, that bastard...!
Nnngh, not yet... NOT YETT...!!
I'm debuting in that exact same year.

All right!! Knew it, gonna train a bit more!!
I'm countin' on your coaching, got it?

For the first time, I shared my brother's regrets. How his dream of conquering the Derby was shattered,
and how we could no longer talk about that dream together.

I pondered how to make her stronger and what she might be lacking.
...In her burning fighting spirit, she seems prone to losing focus over minor things.

What a magnificent run, Agnes Tachyon...!
Such breathtaking speed... And to think she hasn't even debuted yet!

Brutal... Honestly, I feel bad for the girl who lost.
She might've won any other race, but losing like that... That's gotta hurt.
...Ngh, she's so... So far ahead...!
Huh? Don't see why you gotta ask that.
Do you really need a reason to wanna win?

As if sensing her overflowing fighting spirit spinning out of control, her face twisted in frustration.
Ahead of her, Agnes Tachyon smoothly pulled away, extending her lead—
—That's what's the freakin' coolest, ain't it?
—That's why I gotta go beat 'em down.

Jungle Pocket is strong.
She possesses the potential to aim for "the strongest." But...

Right? Man, you really do get it!
So what about you? Why'd you become a fan of Fuji-san?

There's stuff I need to fix, right?
Teach me. Tell me how to get stronger.
She's incredible. And it's a fact that she's stronger than me right now.

When I realized that, I thought, "I gotta jump into that world!"
I couldn't just sit around, so before I knew it, I'd enrolled in Tracen Academy.
—She flashed past the winning post like a streak of light.

Could Agnes Tachyon really overpower
even a girl like her that easily—?

The final three furlongs were around thirty-five seconds, eh...?
—Nowhere near enough yet.
...Dammit!
—Ngh... Damn it all...

Hah, hah...! Urrgh... dammit...!
RAAAAHH!!

Phew... Fuji-san really is incredible.
Running in that mock race just drove home how amazing she is.

That's right—if I'm aiming for the "strongest," I can't let fear hold me back here.
I can't call myself the "strongest" unless I beat the best of the best.

After missing the start, Jungle Pocket was visibly frantic.
In her desperation to catch up, she had lost her own rhythm entirely.

—Ah, splendid. Truly.
Just like this...—straight beyond the horizon of possibility.

I've always run in the free-style underground scene, ya know?
I came here all cocky, thinking I'd see what these polite, prim-and-proper races were made of.

I wanna win just like that!
I wanna run badass and have badass showdowns!
ORAAGH—whoa!?

Yeah, thanks.
...Hey. You got video of Fuji-san's races, right? Mind if I watch 'em?
Fuji-san... always acts like nothing's wrong, but...
Phewww... That was nuts. I can't take another step.
What's that supposed to mean?
—I hear she's finally locked in her debut.
